description: This file defines a Spring component class that implements a command strategy for retrieving a loan charge by external ID within a batch processing context. It processes batch requests, extracts relevant URL parameters, and delegates the API call to the LoanChargesApiResource, handling response construction and error mapping.

classes.name: GetChargeByChargeExternalIdCommandStrategy
classes.description: A Spring component implementing CommandStrategy to fetch a loan charge by external ID, parsing URL parameters and interacting with LoanChargesApiResource.

methods.description: Performs the batch command execution: parses URL, retrieves external IDs, invokes the LoanChargesApiResource, and constructs the BatchResponse.
